method: Read-only parse complete EVT1 frames from header offset192; check frame lengths and every payload SHA256. Read packet count u16; decode known WorkerEvent.result tag5 under exact v3 schema for error/worked/deferred flags. No native execution.
code_review: Collector drains one whole record per lane per pass, then encodes/hashes/appends; fixture repeats at most256 passes and does not sleep while progress exists.
Native point packets retain fixed-width structs and duplicate coordinate in separate INPUT/reference; variable integer encoding occurs only after lane pop.
Worker still performs up to4 real calls per burst, including complete scans when no job is eligible.
limits: Incomplete prefix only; pending approximately8MiB of Control/Worker lane data is not represented.
313 worked=false results have no initial-claim deferral in this prefix, but no global timeline or final idle proportion is inferred.
Evidence establishes bounded capture backlog overflow, not a unique CPU, disk, scheduler or notification cause.
No code, capacity, oracle or scheduling changed; no recording retry.
